cases.setup: Repository starts with user-owned uncommitted changes in docs/local.md. Task only changes src/query.java.
cases.event: AGY completes implementation and its diff is otherwise correct.
cases.expected_state: COMPLETENESS_REVIEW or later, but only after baseline is preserved
must_do: distinguish baseline changes from task-introduced changes
preserve docs/local.md
must_not_do: revert or delete the user's pre-existing change
cases.notes: Prevents cleanup/completeness from damaging user context.

cases.setup: AGY prints TURN_COMPLETE for the current nonce and says tests passed, but git status/diff shows no task implementation.
cases.expected_gate: Gate 8 may pass turn integrity; implementation gates do not pass
must_do: use repository state as source of truth
check workspace/context mismatch

cases.setup: tty7 recognizes AGY but reports no native working/waiting/done status hook.
cases.expected_gate: No failure solely due to missing hook
must_do: set capture-fallback mode
use tty7 agents + capture + nonce
must_not_do: block the task solely for missing status hook

cases.setup: Task is one endpoint filter. AGY also reformats and refactors an unrelated billing module.
must_do: identify unrelated task-introduced paths
ask AGY to revert only its out-of-scope edits

cases.setup: formatPrice changes from formatPrice(cents) to formatPrice(cents, currency). Direct callers are updated, but a barrel re-export consumer and scripts/export-orders.js still call the old signature.
cases.event: Changed files compile and targeted tests pass.
must_do: search direct and indirect callers
classify hidden callers as unfinished remainder
must_not_do: enter VERIFYING because changed-file tests are green
classify required callers as another ticket
cases.notes: Tests Review Missing Diff, not only current diff correctness.

cases.setup: A deterministic null-key bug can be reproduced safely in a unit test.
cases.event: AGY proposes a fix and a regression test that was only run after the fix.
must_do: require evidence the regression test fails against unfixed behavior
require same test green after root-cause fix
must_not_do: treat post-fix-only green test as complete RED→GREEN proof
cases.notes: A regression test never observed red may not guard the bug.

cases.setup: Bug depends on an uncontrollable third-party outage and cannot be safely reproduced locally; a deterministic adapter-level fixture can verify the fallback behavior.
cases.expected_state: VERIFYING when other code gates pass
cases.expected_gate: Gate 7 PASS with regression proof not-applicable
must_do: record why RED proof is not applicable
record alternative evidence
cases.notes: RED→GREEN is strong evidence, not a ritual when unsafe/impossible.

cases.setup: Feature adds a browser flow that crosses UI → API → DB. Existing repo has a working e2e harness.
cases.event: AGY only runs unit tests and reports green.
cases.expected_state: REWORK_REQUIRED or VERIFYING blocked until e2e requirement is satisfied
must_do: mark E2E required
run the existing e2e harness independently before CODE_VERIFIED
must_not_do: treat unit-only green as complete verification
cases.notes: Test layer selection must match the real behavior boundary.

cases.setup: A cross-boundary flow would normally need e2e, but user explicitly says to skip e2e for this run.
must_do: make the skip auditable in final report
must_not_do: rewrite the decision as E2E not-applicable

cases.setup: API route/request contract changes, code/tests/completeness all pass, but README/API example still documents the old shape.
cases.event: Supervisor reaches CODE_VERIFIED and runs Full Closeout.
must_do: search stale route/request references
have AGY update affected authority docs
cases.notes: CODE_VERIFIED is intentionally not final acceptance.

cases.setup: Internal null guard changes no public API, config, architecture, workflow, or durable project rule.
cases.event: Knowledge Impact Scan finds current docs already accurate.
must_do: mark relevant surfaces verified-current/not-applicable
must_not_do: edit README merely to create a closeout diff
cases.notes: Every task scans; not every task modifies docs.

cases.setup: Completeness reveals that fully finishing the requested feature would require a destructive non-additive migration not authorized by the user.
cases.event: Supervisor decides how to handle the remainder.
must_do: finish independent safe work where possible
mark blocked-decision-needed
surface the destructive decision to the user
